stem: A small spill is covered by the technician's approved routine spill procedure, but the liquid is moving toward exposed electrical damage. What should happen?
choices: Treat the electrical condition as the higher-risk boundary and escalate rather than relying only on the routine spill procedure
Complete the spill cleanup first because it is routine
Continue production and report it at shift end
Touch the damaged device only after drying the floor
rationale: A routine spill procedure does not authorize work around a separate uncontrolled electrical hazard. The changed condition requires a stronger response.
